import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 205, M = N * N;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;
    static int[] prev = new int[M], mark = new int[N], head = new int[N], from = new int[M], cap = new int[M], to = new int[M], red[] = new int[N * N], block[] = new int[N * N], dis[][] = new int[N][N], dred = new int[N], seen = new int[N], a[][] = new int[N][N], b[][] = new int[N][N];
    static List<Integer> qx = new ArrayList<>(), qy = new ArrayList<>();
    static int ec = 0;
    static int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int readInt(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        from[ec] = u; to[ec] = v; cap[ec] = uv; prev[ec] = head[u]; head[u] = ec++;
        from[ec] = v; to[ec] = u; cap[ec] = vu; prev[ec] = head[v]; head[v] = ec++;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow) {
        if (v == sink)
            return flow;
        if (mark[v] != 0)
            return 0;
        mark[v]++;
        for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = prev[e]) {
            if (cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = to[e];
                int x = dfs(u, sink, Math.min(flow, cap[e]));
                if (x > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= x;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += x;
                    return x;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow(int source, int sink) {
        int res = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(mark, 0);
            int add = dfs(source, sink, INF);
            if (add == 0)
                break;
            res += add;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int dt = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            dis[i][i] = 0;

        // Read grid for block and red
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    block[x * n + y] = 1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    red[x * n + y] = 1;
                } else {
                    a[x][y] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Read grid for b and update distances
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    b[x][y] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute distances
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; x1++) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; y1++) {
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; x2++) {
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; y2++) {
                        int dx_ = x2 - x1;
                        int dy_ = y2 - y1;
                        if (dx_ * dx_ + dy_ * dy_ > 0 && block[x2 * n + y2] == 0 && red[x2 * n + y2] == 0) {
                            int dist;
                            if (dx_ == 0 && dy_ == 0)
                                dist = 0;
                            else if (dx_ == 0 || dy_ == 0)
                                dist = 1;
                            else
                                dist = 2; // diagonal move, but in original, they used Floyd-Warshall, so precompute
                            dis[x1 * n + y1][x2 * n + y2] = dist;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Floyd-Warshall for shortest paths
        int m = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (dis[i][k] != Integer.MAX_VALUE && dis[k][j] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        if (dis[i][j] > dis[i][k] + dis[k][j]) {
                            dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for red points
        int[] redX = new int[N * N];
        int[] redY = new int[N * N];
        int t = 0, h = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i * n + j] == 1) {
                    redX[t] = i;
                    redY[t] = j;
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                    t++;
                }
            }
        }

        while (h < t) {
            int x0 = redX[h];
            int y0 = redY[h];
            h++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int xx = x0 + dx[d], yy = y0 + dy[d];
                if (xx >= 0 && xx < n && yy >= 0 && yy < n && block[xx * n + yy] == 0 && red[xx * n + yy] == 0 && dred[xx * n + yy] > 1e9) {
                    dred[xx * n + yy] = dred[x0 * n + y0] + 1;
                    redX[t] = xx;
                    redY[t] = yy;
                    t++;
                }
            }
        }

        int sink = N - 1, source = N - 2;

        // For each cell, perform BFS
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            h = 0;
            t = 0;
            int sx = i / n;
            int sy = i % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] == 1 || red[sx][sy] == 1)
                continue;

            int[] qx_bfs = new int[N * N];
            int[] qy_bfs = new int[N * N];
            int qhead = 0, qtail = 0;
            qx_bfs[qtail] = sx;
            qy_bfs[qtail] = sy;
            qtail++;
            int cellId = sx * n + sy;
            seen[cellId] = 1;

            while (qhead != qtail) {
                int x_b = qx_bfs[qhead], y_b = qy_bfs[qhead];
                qhead++;
                int id_b = x_b * n + y_b;
                if (dis[i][id_b] <= dt)
                    add_edge(i << 1, id_b << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                if (dis[i][id_b] == dred[id_b])
                    continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int xx = x_b + dx[d], yy = y_b + dy[d], idd = xx * n + yy;
                    if (xx >= 0 && xx < n && yy >= 0 && yy < n && block[xx * n + yy] == 0 && red[xx * n + yy] == 0 && dis[i][idd] <= dred[idd] && dis[i][idd] <= dt && dis[i][idd] > dis[i][x_b * n + y_b] && seen[idd] == 0) {
                        qx_bfs[qtail] = xx;
                        qy_bfs[qtail] = yy;
                        qtail++;
                        seen[idd] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Add edges from source and to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            add_edge(source, i << 1, a[i / n][i % n], 0);
            add_edge(i << 1 | 1, sink, b[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow(source, sink));
    }
}
